name: The Only Cure is More Green Glow
label: Quest
description: In Kharanos, Ozzie Togglevolt seeks a cure for the leper gnomes.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Kharanos, Ozzie Togglevolt seeks a cure for the leper gnomes.

Ozzie Togglevolt's first tests outside Gnomeregan brought no answers. The troggs roaming Dun Morogh carried too little residue, and what they bore was impure. From his lab in Kharanos, Ozzie now seeks a fresh, concentrated sample from deep inside the city, hoping it will help him find a remedy for the leper gnomes.

You need to gather potent fallout from within Gnomeregan. The lower depths around the Hall of Gears and Clean Zone are filled with irradiated horrors, lurkers, and slimes. Collecting their unstable ooze in a heavy leaden phial is dangerous. The fallout quickly loses its potency, so it must reach Ozzie's lab in Kharanos in time.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Not only was your sample insufficient in quantity, it was also impure.

What we require is more green glow. The troggs are obviously not irradiated sufficiently to fulfill our needs. You will have to go into Gnomeregan and bring back some radioactive fallout, straight from the tap. I am speaking of the irradiated slimes, lurkers and horrors. Be warned, the containment of this type of fallout is difficult. You may need to make several attempts with the phial until a suitable sampling is recovered.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hrm, you're not glowing. That's a good sign.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Impressive, you still have all of your limbs. Now it's time to see what this stuff can do!
